brief:
The Palestinian Red Crescent transported the body of a youth killed by Israeli occupation forces on Friday from the Qizzan al-Najjar area south of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The deceased was identified as Ibrahim Muhammad. No additional details about the circumstances surrounding the shooting were provided in initial reports.

The incident marks another casualty in the ongoing conflict in Gaza's southern region. Khan Younis, one of the territory's largest cities, has been a focal point of Israeli military operations throughout the war.
